content.what_it_is: A multi-GPU Makefile for FUNWAVE-GPU. It builds funwave_mtsu with mpif90, single precision, ZALPHA, USE_CUDA, PGI, and MGPU macros, CUDA 10.1/cuSPARSE options, and a source group that adds mod_cuda.F, mgpu_utilities.F, and GPU kernel files. It also defines preprocessing, compilation, linking, archiving, clean, and clobber rules (lines 1-116).

MPI compiler and CUDA option definitions (lines 32-46)

unresolved: CPPARGS references FLAG_1 through FLAG_24, but many are commented out and FLAG_5 plus FLAG_23-FLAG_24 have no definitions in this Makefile (lines 11-31, 50-56); their empty or externally supplied resolution is not documented.

INCS and LIBS definitions are commented out (lines 61-62), and LDFLAGS is not defined in this file, although the compile/link recipes reference INCS, LDFLAGS, and LIBS (lines 72, 97); their external or empty resolution is unspecified.

The multi-GPU macro FLAG_20=-DMGPU is active and mpif90 is selected (lines 29, 37), but FLAG_2=-DPARALLEL is commented out (line 12); the Makefile does not explain whether MGPU mode intentionally operates without the PARALLEL macro.
